data.normalizedTarget: there is one move we can make

manualReview.scope: Model/editor semantic and pedagogy review of the current Lesson 0138 listening-focus draft; not an independent human or real-learner test.

englishNaturalness.evidence: ‘There is one move we can make.’, ‘Is there another move?’ and ‘There is another move.’ are natural uses of noun move as an available action/decision.

persianMeaningQuality.evidence: The bounded noun sense is represented naturally as «اقدام», avoiding confusion with physical movement.

pedagogicalClarity.evidence: A02 exposes both exchanges before A03/A06/A07/A09 listening, reconstruction or retrieval dependencies.

distractorQuality.evidence: choice/problem alternatives are grammatical, natural and semantically contrastive; all English distractors have explicit model audits.

dialoguePlausibility.evidence: آوا و بن در کافه برای حل یک مشکل ساده در سفارش درباره قدم بعدی تصمیم می‌گیرند.

difficultyFit.evidence: One target noun is practiced in a controlled there-be frame with two short listening checks.

repetitionUsefulness.evidence: move repeats only in the decision/action sense across one-move and another-move contexts.

transferQuality.evidence: Learner moves from one available action to another while keeping the same noun sense.

overallCoherence.evidence: Problem-solving story and the added second-exchange comprehension make listening the genuine lesson focus while retaining target control.

learnerExperience.evidence: Dependency order was audited but no real learner testing is claimed.

runtimeAssetGrounding.evidence: No visual claim exists; every listening source is an audioRequired turn already exposed in A02.

limitations: No independent human or real learner test has been performed.
Only noun move meaning an action/decision is assessed; physical movement is excluded.
Generated audio pronunciation/prosody is not evaluated at this text stage.
